request: Analyze GSE205891 for PMID 36084645 (Worksite-based intensive lifestyle therapy has profound cardiometabolic benefits in people with obesity and type 2 diabetes.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000), human skeletal muscle and subcutaneous abdominal adipose tissue biopsies (S4.3.4.2.p1, key resources table)
final.primary_estimand: Within-group change in skeletal muscle gene expression after vs before 8 months of intensive lifestyle therapy (ILT: dietary energy restriction plus supervised exercise training 4 x 60 min/week) in people with obesity and T2D; the same within-group change in the standard-care (SC) arm is reported alongside (S2.6.p1, FIG3). Exercise is not separable from energy restriction/weight loss in this design: the estimand is the effect of the combined lifestyle intervention.
final.repeated_measure_unit: participant (before and after biopsies from the same person)
final.inclusion: Muscle RNA-seq: SC n=6, ILT n=8 participants (FIG3); adipose: SC n=7, ILT n=10 (FIG4). 9 women + 1 man in ILT, 8 women in SC among completers (S2.1.p1).
planned_contrasts: Muscle ILT after vs before, paired (S2.6.p1, FIG3A; paper: 1,540 DEGs, Table S3)
Muscle SC after vs before, paired (S2.6.p1, FIG3A; paper: 65 DEGs, Table S2)

Adipose ILT and SC after vs before: selected-gene results only (S2.7.p1, FIG4; ECM genes SPARC, LOX, LOXL1, TNMD, PDGFA, SEMA3C down after ILT; IL6, TNF, CCL2, CCL5, CD68, CD74 unchanged); no DEG count reported
final.paper_method: edgeR (P value and FDR per gene) on gene counts (featureCounts); pairing in the edgeR model not stated (S4.4.p1)
final.normalization: CPM from featureCounts gene counts; deposited file is log-transformed (moderated) CPM (GEO data_processing)

paper_results.pathways: IPA top pathways in ILT muscle: Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Oxidative Phosphorylation, TCA Cycle II, Sirtuin Signaling, NAD Signaling (FIG3B)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.6.p1 and FIG3 define the muscle DEG analysis as after-vs-before within each arm with log2|FC|>0.3 and FDR<0.05; S4.4.p1 names edgeR; key resources table names GSE205891 for muscle RNA-seq. S2.7.p1/FIG4 report adipose selected genes only. S1.p3/S4.3.3.p1: ILT = energy restriction + supervised exercise; the transcriptomic effect cannot be attributed to exercise alone.

GEO growth protocol describes muscle and SAT from people with obesity and T2D before/after SC and ILT
28 muscle samples = 14 subjects x 2 (SC 6 + ILT 8, matches FIG3); 34 adipose samples = 17 x 2 (SC 7 + ILT 10, matches FIG4)

Paper input was raw counts (edgeR); raw counts were not deposited and cannot be recovered without library sizes.

design.reasoning: Paper (S2.6.p1, FIG3A) reports after-vs-before DEGs within each arm in muscle. Tissue and arm are strata; time is the tested factor with subject blocking. The randomized arm x time contrast (ILT change minus SC change) is added as exploratory because it best isolates the lifestyle effect from season/time; the paper uses this ANCOVA-type comparison only for selected genes. Estimand note: ILT combines energy restriction (17% weight loss) with exercise training, so effects are of lifestyle therapy, not exercise alone.

covariance.reasoning: Before and after biopsies come from the same participant, so participant is a blocking factor (paired design; paper uses paired t-tests for within-group changes, S4.4.p1). No batch or sex column in GEO; sex (1 man in ILT) is constant within subject and absorbed by the subject block.

final.method: limma (moderated t, eBayes) with subject blocking, on deposited log2 CPM

paper_route.reason: raw counts not deposited; only moderated log2 CPM available, and library sizes are not provided to back-calculate counts

deviations: limma on log2 CPM instead of edgeR on counts
low-expression filter log2CPM >= 0 (about CPM >= 1) in at least as many samples as the smaller time group of the execution, a standard edgeR/limma step the paper does not describe
duplicated gene symbols (121 extra rows) collapsed by the executor to the highest-mean row
pairing by subject explicitly modelled; paper's edgeR pairing unstated

method.reasoning: Matrix and method policy: log-scale CPM goes to limma. Paired design ~ subject + time within each arm/tissue subset.

final.deviation_note: paper rule (FDR<0.05 and log2|FC|>0.3) applied unchanged to limma BH-adjusted p and limma log2 fold change

caveats: Exercise is confounded with dietary energy restriction and ~17% weight loss in ILT; results describe lifestyle therapy, not exercise alone.
Paper used edgeR on counts; this run uses limma on deposited log2 CPM, so DEG counts are not expected to match exactly.
Within-arm before/after changes are not randomized comparisons; the arm x time exploratory contrast is the randomized estimand but has low power (6 vs 8 subjects).
